node.title: Re^3: Named Entity alternative to Lingua::EN::NamedEntity
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: That's a problem with the installation of [mod://DB_File], not [mod://Lingua::EN::NamedEntity]. You said earlier you tried on Strawberry Perl, but the [http://strawberryperl.com/releases.html|release notes] indicate that [mod://DB_File] is already included there as far back as 5.10.1, so what problem did you have there? As for ActivePerl, [https://code.activestate.com/ppm/DB_File/|this page] does seem to indicate that there are no PPMs available. It's been way too long since I last used ActivePerl to be able to help there, but I have had good experiences with Strawberry Perl so I would recommend that instead, because it includes all the build tools you need.
